column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a Copilot resume, which keeps its banner, appends a lifecycle row of kind resume too
a checkout with no commit yet records its HEAD as unborn
a clear appends one lifecycle row of kind clear
a compact appends one lifecycle row of kind compact
a governed directory that is not a git checkout records its HEAD as -, not unborn
a payload of 30,000 lines carrying source is answered by its first, recorded inside thirty seconds, and the resume stays silent
a payload with no session_id or transcript_path writes - in lifecycle fields 3 and 8
a refused handoff appends a lifecycle row noted refused, with the hash of the file it left alone
a resume appends one lifecycle row of kind resume, and the hook prints nothing at all and exits 0
a startup appends exactly one row to the project's lifecycle.log
a transcript path holding a tab still leaves nine lifecycle fields, the path kept whole in field 8
an engine with no plugin.json of its own records - as the bound engine, never the registry's version
an ungoverned directory writes no lifecycle.log, under the memory root or in its tree, where a governed start does
and the handoff row names the engine that wrote it and the checkout's HEAD
and the lifecycle row has nine tab-separated fields
and the resume row names the engine, the installed engine, the HEAD, the handoff and the transcript
as a plain settings.json hook, with no CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, the lifecycle row still names its own engine
felix handoff --replace over a hand-written handoff appends a row noted replaced, with the hash of what replaced it
felix handoff appends one lifecycle row of kind handoff, noted written, with the hash of the file it wrote
hooks/session-start records above the resume exit, and its comment saying the record sits above sits between the two
lib/lifecycle.sh opens by dating its exception to rows-first, 2026-09-21, and names the schemas.tsv row owed with queue item 2
lifecycle field 1 is a UTC ISO 8601 stamp, the format the other memory logs use
lifecycle field 2 is the SessionStart source, startup
lifecycle field 3 is the payload's session id
lifecycle field 4 is the engine running the hook, read from its own plugin.json
lifecycle field 5 is the version the Claude Code registry has installed for felix
lifecycle field 6 is the full sha of the checkout's HEAD
lifecycle field 7 is git hash-object of the project's SESSION_HANDOFF.md
lifecycle field 8 is the payload's transcript path
lifecycle field 9, the note, is - on a session row
lifecycle.log is written under the memory root and nowhere in the checkout
the next session start records the same handoff hash the handoff row did
two session starts append two lifecycle rows in order and rewrite none of the bytes before them
with no Claude Code registry in HOME, the installed engine is - and the bound one is still read
with no session handoff on disk, lifecycle field 7 is -
